gruss_morgen.text: FRESH GOODS! FRESH MORNING! Both on offer today! The morning is free, the rest we negotiate!

gruss_tag.text: Marta! Market woman! Best goods in the valley! I'm not shouting, I'm speaking ENTHUSIASTICALLY!

gruss_abend.text: Closing-time prices! Everything must go! Well, not EVERYTHING everything. The stall stays. So does Marta.

gruss_regen.text: RAIN DISCOUNT! Ten percent off everything that's allowed to get wet! Nothing off you, you're priceless!

gruss_freund.text: THERE'S my treasure! Come here! I put something aside for you under the counter. Under the counter is the VIP shelf!

hub.text: What'll it be, what'll it be?

optionen.text: Why did you become a market woman?

text: The berries are selling like hotcakes! The hotcakes too, by the way. Everything sells like something!
Only the crooked pumpkin stays behind. I named him Kurt. Kurt is family now.
Between us: the market shouting is showbiz. After closing time I even whisper. Almost.
Yesterday I said thank you quietly and three customers got startled. A reputation must be defended!
You're my favorite customer, you know that? And I don't say that to everyone! Only to almost everyone!
No, honestly. With you I mean it. Kurt the pumpkin nods too. See? Family resolution.

quest_vergabe.text: Do I EVER need help! Special order! Exclusive! Today only! Only you!

quest_annahme.text: DEAL! Handshake! Firmer! FIRMER! That's how we do business!

ablehnung.text: Hard bargaining! Respect! The offer stands — like Kurt. He's not going anywhere either.

quest_abgabe.text: DELIVERY COMPLETE! First-class work, as ordered! Here's your pay — and I'll throw in extra, but don't tell anyone!

geschenk_liebt.text: BERRIES! And what berries! Plump! Glossy! I'm not selling these, I'm eating them! Right now! You're my witness!

geschenk_mag.text: For ME? Treasure, you know how to move a market woman! This goes in the display window. As decoration. MY decoration.

geschenk_normal.text: Oh! Er! Market value... hard to appraise! But the sentimental value — ENORMOUS! Thanks, treasure!

text: Whether the last piece is really the last? ... Fine. I'll tell you. There is always one more crate.
ALWAYS. Behind the stall. The last piece is a state of mind, not an inventory count.
But don't you dare rat me out! Or next week the berries will HAPPEN to be sold out. For you. Personally.
Why a market woman? Child, I used to be shy. SHY! I didn't even dare order bread rolls.
One day an old market woman shoved a crate of apples into my hands and said: shout or starve.
I shouted. Sold three apples. To myself. But it was a START!

tschuess.text: See you soon, treasure! I'll shout after you so you don't forget the way! SEE YOU SOOOOON!
